scope: Second bounded review of the 43 legacy packages: common Tools argument positions, return properties, and the enhanced command execution chain

confirmed_fixes.issue: String false enabled packages instead of disabling them
confirmed_fixes.evidence: operit_editor.set_sandbox_package_enabled forwards string|number|boolean unchanged; old StandardSoftwareSettingsModifyTools.parseBooleanParameter accepts false/0/off; JS truthy branch previously enabled all nonempty strings
confirmed_fixes.change: Strictly parse supported old boolean spellings before choosing package enable/disable

confirmed_fixes.issue: New/edited intent workflow listeners required app restart
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Workflow Android startup restored actions, while prior Workflow CRUD shim did not invoke refresh
confirmed_fixes.change: Read real events and refresh Android receivers after get/CRUD mutations

confirmed_fixes.issue: Workflow errors and complex parameters lost their contract
confirmed_fixes.evidence: LegacyWorkflowService execution nodes are an object; actionConfig values are serialized strings; shim used Array.filter and directly passed turns/function_type
confirmed_fixes.change: Object node results retain their IDs; explicitly parse structured/numeric/boolean fields and map chat parameters

confirmed_fixes.issue: Direct scripts bypassed VFS and old Tools compatibility
confirmed_fixes.evidence: script_run read source_path/env_file_path with std::fs and created fresh native Tools engine
confirmed_fixes.change: Read files through Files.read full-content binding and real path resolver; bind legacy factory inside source; return actual old-shaped success/error result

confirmed_fixes.issue: Stop could miss a queued planning request
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Cancellation registration used to occur only after async task began
confirmed_fixes.change: Register before scheduling/returning job ID, check token before sending, remove on completion or enqueue error

confirmed_fixes.issue: Changing STT provider kept the previous request/auth schema
confirmed_fixes.evidence: speech_set replaced providerType only; TTS path already reset catalog defaults
confirmed_fixes.change: Install target STT catalog endpoint/model/field names/response path/headers before applying explicit user values

confirmed_fixes.issue: Google built-in search added to a model could conflict with external tools
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Current ModelCatalog uses ExclusiveWithExternalTools; fallback adapter used CanMixWithExternalTools
confirmed_fixes.change: Use the same exclusive flag as the current catalog

confirmed_fixes.issue: Old compatible VITS settings were only retained despite a reusable current Sherpa engine
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Current LocalModelDriver supports SherpaOnnxVits; old package and ONNX metadata determine whether the model is actually compatible
confirmed_fixes.change: Prepare/register compatible model and engine in a background job, bind real LOCAL_MODEL and speaker on success; reject custom unsupported models without replacing active TTS

confirmed_fixes.issue: Speech engine settings could remain inactive or fail before first STT selection
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Old engine names had no concrete provider; speech_get/set unconditionally required current STT; current first-run store explicitly permits no selected recognizer
confirmed_fixes.change: Real WebSocket, Deepgram, NCNN and native VITS providers connected; exact backend profile committed after preparation, initial STT create/select supported and TTS no longer depends on selected STT

confirmed_fixes.issue: Old Claude one-hour cache switch was retained without changing real API requests
confirmed_fixes.evidence: Original ClaudeProvider.cacheControlObject sets ephemeral ttl=1h; current provider cache-boundary function was empty while system blocks independently received default controls
confirmed_fixes.change: Persist actual model cache_control parameter, migrate retained setting, apply it at stable cacheable request boundaries, and filter it from other provider dialects

checks: One targeted contract smoke for false toggle, workflow receiver update, failure node details, stored chat payload conversion, and script Tools/env context

Earlier 214-patch snapshot: Rust 1.95.0 command-core and proxy-local compile passed, including LegacyVitsImport. This predates the new Claude/Deepgram/WebSocket/NCNN/native-VITS integration; its consolidated compilation is tracked separately by the root agent

Actual enhanced Claude request construction and cache-boundary functions compiled and executed with deterministic serializer/tool inputs: 1h on enable, default TTL on disable, three boundaries, no thinking marker or automatic-cache collision
pending: Full Android APK/JNI build and actual device behavior are root-coordinated; no device success is claimed

vits_import.execution: Background preparation tries the compatible Sherpa import first; custom Operit1 ONNX VITS uses the real Android ONNX Runtime provider. Only validated, ready-to-use configuration is committed.
vits_import.supported: Sherpa-compatible VITS plus old custom ONNX VITS tensor names, token/front-end options and speaker selection supported by the actual native graph; package paths accept readable directories, ZIPs and file URLs.
vits_import.failure_behavior: Malformed models, unsupported required native graph inputs, missing model assets or incompatible speed/scale input fail with a specific reason and preserve the previous TTS configuration.

claude_prompt_cache.request_behavior: The actual Claude request builder consumes this parameter and applies its TTL at the final tool, final system block and final cacheable message block. It does not send simultaneous automatic caching, and skips thinking blocks. Other provider dialects do not receive this parameter.
claude_prompt_cache.migration: Previously retained values migrate into real model parameters when the legacy configuration editor reads them; explicit writes apply to all models in the legacy configuration.
claude_prompt_cache.evidence: claude-cache-request-sample.json, compiled extracted real request builder with fixture history/tool inputs; no API request sent

runtime_requirements: Actual device authorization for Android operations
First-use local model/engine downloads or verified local imported assets
User credentials and reachable configured speech/model endpoints
Model graphs and selected options must be supported by their real engine; invalid input is rejected
Per-request non-neutral pitch is implemented by system TTS, not non-system audio playback

speech_engines.OPENAI_WS_TTS: Real WebSocket audio protocol, configured endpoint/key/model/voice, response audio delta decoding and WAV output; complete credentials checked at synthesis so the profile can be created first.
speech_engines.DEEPGRAM_STT: Real raw-audio HTTP request, Token authorization, model/language query parameters and exact transcript response path; no multipart substitution.
speech_engines.SHERPA_NCNN: Existing original seven-file bilingual model set verified by SHA-256, exact native NCNN engine on Android, configured through LOCAL_MODEL after preparation; SHERPA_MNN preserves the original NCNN alias.
speech_engines.VITS_TTS: LegacyVitsNative selects validated Sherpa LOCAL_MODEL or actual LEGACY_VITS ONNX Runtime synthesis.
speech_engines.configuration: TTS can be read/changed before STT is selected; first successful STT setup creates and selects its profile. Missing credentials remain a setup prerequisite, not a claimed successful API call.
speech_engines.pitch: System TTS applies requested pitch; non-system synthesized-audio playback does not claim pitch adjustment. A non-neutral explicit per-call pitch is rejected, and test results report the actual pitch.
